text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":30,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"30 oatmeal cookies"},{"id":"q2","value":48,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"48 chocolate chip cookies"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"Euclidean subtraction: 48-30, replacing the larger with the difference to move toward the greatest common factor"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"subtract again: 30-18, continuing the Euclidean algorithm"},{"op":"sub","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract again: 18-12, still narrowing toward the greatest common factor"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"final subtraction: 12-6=6; since both remaining values are now equal, this is the greatest common factor -- the number of containers needed"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"number of containers Kiara needs"},"dismissed":[]}
